featured_reviews.name: Ashok Rajpurohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this medical college for my cousin brother’s admission. We had every required document from the domicile certificate to the health certificate everything was complete. We applied under the EWS category, but the staff refused to accept the proper EWS certificate and claimed that it was for the All India quota instead of the State quota. How are normal people supposed to know these technical differences? They also pointed out minor, unnecessary issues in the health certificate.

We immediately arranged a new health certificate from a local clinic, but getting a fresh EWS certificate was impossible since it can only be issued through government offices and the next day was a Sunday, which also happened to be the last day for admissions. When we asked the staff for any possible solution, they simply refused. It became clear that they were more interested in selling the seat under the management quota for huge sums of money rather than helping genuine students.

They do not think even once before jeopardizing a young student’s future.

My advice to students: Avoid taking admission here.

My message to the management: Please take strict action and replace such irresponsible staff.

featured_reviews.name: Zeenat Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this college for enquiry and document verification, and the experience was highly disappointing. Upon entry, all electronic devices were taken away, apparently to prevent visitors from documenting the poor state of the campus. The road leading to the college was in terrible condition, with no proper staircase access provided.

The infrastructure is extremely poor — from classrooms to parking facilities, nothing seemed well-maintained. To make matters worse, the staff was very unprofessional, dismissive, and even rude. Instead of clarifying queries regarding required documents, she told me “not to overreact” simply because I cross-verified the details.
Overall, the college gave a very negative impression due to its mismanagement, rude staff, and lack of basic infrastructure. Definitely not the kind of environment one would expect for serious education.
